{{Quote|At my ''command''&mdash;FIRE!|The Imperial officer orders stormtroopers to open fire on Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="APL" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as an '''officer''' under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Corwyth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|infiltrated]] the [[Factory/Legends|factory]] planet in order to spread the seeds of rebellion among the uninformed worker populace, which had little knowledge of the outside [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and its current events.

Ordered to find Organa, the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] used a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] implanted in a stolen [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to track her to an [[ore processing center]]. When the [[Cargo crawler|conveyor]] bucket that the tracking device was broadcasting from appeared within the line of sight of the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the officer ordered the stormtroopers to open fire. After the smoke had cleared, they discovered that Organa had escaped, and all that was present in the conveyor bucket was the stolen blaster.

==Biography==
===Empire on Metalorn===
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] served the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]],<ref name="APL" /> located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Metalorn system/Legends|Metalorn system]]</ref> The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] worked under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the planet's Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Corwyth]].<ref name="APL" />

Under Corwyth, the smog-and-[[Factory/Legends|factory]]-covered Metalorn was kept isolated from outside influences, which left the local populace unaware of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] movement fighting the rule of the Empire in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In addition, Corwyth designed an elaborate security system centered around the use of [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking devices]] in electrical equipment and weapons. As such, if an individual ever stole a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], the Imperials could easily locate that person due to the tracking device built into the gun.<ref name="APL" />

===Renegade princess===
{{Quote|Set all blasters at low level intensity&mdash;we want to destroy the ''woman'', not the conveyer!|The Imperial officer preparing subordinates for confrontation|<ref name="APL" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]] takes place after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which includes the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but before the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]]. Given that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] as the final event of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and also dates Tagge's death to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the events of ''Star Wars 30'' must therefore take place in 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the Rebel [[Prince/Legends|princess]] from the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], attempted to [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|infiltrate Metalorn]] in order to bring the world out of the dark and take the planet's populace to the brink of rebellion. Not long into her mission, Organa encountered a [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Metalorn)|lone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], whom she dispatched; unaware of the tracking device in the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] blaster, Organa took the weapon for herself and proceeded with her mission.<ref name="APL" />

[[File:Metalorn_Officer_commands_troops.png|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial officer commands troops on Metalorn during the search for Leia Organa.]]
The Imperial officer was tasked with tracking down the stolen blaster by using the device implanted inside of it, though being unaware of the identity of the woman who had stolen it. Troopers chased Organa to an [[ore processing center]], where she hopped onto an [[Cargo crawler|ore conveyor]] cart that carried her through the facility to a chamber designated [[Smelter Bay Five]]. The officer reached the chamber ahead of her and had the troopers prepare for her arrival, stationing them along a catwalk above the conveyor. The officer's plan was to blast Organa as soon as she appeared. Meanwhile, the heightened activity was passed along as nothing more than a security test to the curious populace.<ref name="APL" />

While riding the conveyor, Organa discovered the security system and its relation to her weapon, and she ditched the moving cart while leaving the blaster behind. When the cart arrived in the officer's secured chamber, the troopers opened fire on the former's command. Once the smoke dissipated, the Imperials quickly discovered that the princess had escaped, much to the officer's frustration. The officer then reported back to Corwyth, who could only vent his grievances on his [[Unidentified radio officer|radio officer]]. Ultimately, Organa's mission was a success, persuading her old mentor [[Arn Horada]] to help spread a rebel movement through the planet's populace. The officer's failure culminated with Organa's escape from Metalorn.<ref name="APL" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The ''Rebel's'' not in the car&hellip; only the stolen ''weapon!''<s></s>|The Imperial officer realizes the failure|<ref name="APL" />}}
The Imperial officer was loyal to the Empire and was able to effectively command stormtroopers. Upon learning that Princess Leia Organa was riding in an ore cart through the ore processing center, the officer ordered the troopers to lower the power settings on their weapons so as not to damage the surrounding valuable industrial equipment. The officer had light skin and [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="APL" />

==Equipment==
The officer wore a standard-issue [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|Imperial uniform]] on Metalorn and used a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] with a hooded [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and an adjustable power setting as a sidearm.<ref name="APL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial officer was created for the [[Star Wars (1977) 30|thirthieth issue]] of the [[Marvel Comics]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] series. The issue was written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]] and [[Gene Day]], and released in [[December]] [[1979]].<ref name="APL" />
